title: Full Circle in Japan: Carlos Yulo Completes His Gold Medal Collection With Asian Games Victory
summary: Japan will always be Carlos Yulo’s second home, and on Thursday, the country became even more special as he secured the missing piece in his collection of gold medals from major competitions.
